spells.notes: Kim Young-sam appointee still in office on 1998-02-25 (caretaker holdover until the first 김대중 cabinet of 1998-03-03). Start date is outside the window and rests on the ministry list and Wikipedia only (no digital gazette before 2001). Hanja 尹汝儁 from the NA member file (Wikipedia prints 尹汝雋). Birth date from the NA member file and ko.wikipedia person page https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=42274560 (출생일 1939-10-17, snapshot roster/sources/environment/wiki_people/wiki_윤여준.json, accessed 2026-09-25T13:37:46-0400, secondary). [verifier] Start is disputed. Six dailies of 1997-08-06 (동아일보, 경향신문, 매일경제, 한겨레, 세계일보, 서울경제) report that 김영삼 carried out the 8·5 개각 and appointed the new ministers on 1997-08-05, while the 임명장 were handed over at 09:30 on 1997-08-06 (연합뉴스). The ministry list and ko.wikipedia give 1997-08-06. The value is kept, as in most sibling rosters for the same reshuffle (justice uses 1997-08-05). The start lies before the window and does not affect any in-window day. End confirmed by 1998-03-03 reports of the first 김대중 cabinet and by the 법제처 reading that sitting ministers stay until successors are appointed (한겨레 1998-02-27).

spells.notes: Promoted from 환경부 차관. Stayed as a holdover under 이명박 from 2008-02-25 because the 당선인's nominee 박은경 withdrew (2008-02-27). Left with a farewell ceremony on 2008-02-29, the day 법률 제8852호 took effect and the first 이명박 ministers were appointed. [verifier] On 2008-02-28 청와대 spokesman 이동관 announced that, because three designated ministers had withdrawn, 박명재, 변재진 and 이규용 would be relieved of their minister posts but keep 국무위원 status to make up the 국무회의 quorum (이데일리, 매일경제, 머니투데이, 아시아경제, 한국일보, 파이낸셜뉴스 2008-02-28). He held his 이임식 as 환경부장관 on 2008-02-29 and attended the first 이명박 국무회의 on 2008-03-03 as a 무임소 국무위원 (문화일보 2008-03-03). The 환경부장관 spell therefore ends 2008-02-29. His residual 국무위원 status is not a spell of this lineage (the sibling rosters treat 변재진, 임상규 and 박명재 the same way). The exact effective date of the relief was not printed, so end_confidence is medium. end_reason resigned is kept (the 참여정부 ministers had filed blanket resignations). issues.desc: 김명자 start. There is no digital gazette before 2001. Six dailies (동아일보, 서울신문, 문화일보, 경기일보, 매일신문, 경남신문, all 1999-06-25) and 연합뉴스 1999-06-24 report that 김대중 accepted 손숙's resignation and appointed 김명자 on 1999-06-24. The 임명장 was given on 1999-06-25. The ministry list prints 1999.06.27 and Wikipedia and Wikidata give 1999-06-25. The roster uses 1999-06-24 and ends 손숙 the same day.

한명숙 end. She submitted her resignation on 2004-02-15, the candidate resignation deadline for the 2004-04-15 election. Reports of 2004-02-16 call her resigned but none gives the date the resignation was accepted. The end follows the ministry list, Wikipedia and Wikidata (2004-02-16). The one-day vacancy on 2004-02-17 before 곽결호's appointment has no documented acting head.

김완섭 end. He took leave of staff on 2025-07-16 in place of a farewell ceremony, and Wikipedia ends his term that day. No report of a 면직 or of an accepted resignation was found (Naver and BigKinds searches 2025-07-10..07-24). The ministry list and the successor's gazette date give 2025-07-22, which the roster uses as inferred_from_successor. If a 면직 took effect earlier there was a vacancy of up to six days.

한정애 end. She held a farewell on 2022-05-09 after submitting her resignation with six other party-member ministers, but 문재인 left her 면직안 and three others unprocessed (서울경제 and 연합뉴스, 2022-05-09). Her successor was appointed on 2022-05-10. The roster ends her spell on 2022-05-10 (inferred_from_successor, matching the ministry list and Wikidata). Wikipedia gives 2022-05-09.

Continuity. Four vacancies exist between spells. 2004-02-17 (1 day, 한명숙 to 곽결호), 2006-03-22..2006-04-06 (16 days, 이재용 to 이치범), 2007-09-05..2007-09-20 (16 days, 이치범 to 이규용) and 2008-03-01..2008-03-10 (10 days, 이규용 to 이만의). The 2006, 2007 and 2008 vacancies follow a resignation or relief with the successor still in the hearing process. The 2004 vacancy is the day between 한명숙's exit and 곽결호's appointment (named 2004-02-17, no hearing then). No spell is missing. See acting for the vice ministers in office. No overlaps. The 2025-09-30 to 2025-10-01 change is a reorganization with the same person.

The ministry list (mcee.go.kr) differs from the gazette on 이재용's start (list 2005.06.28, gazette 2005-06-29, the announcement was on 06-28). Its end dates equal the successor's start in every case, including 김완섭 (2025.07.22) and 한정애 (2022.05.10), so it is not independent evidence of a legal exit date.

The Wikipedia list uses ceremony or next-day dates in several places. It gives 이만의 2008-03-12..2011-06-01, 유영숙 from 2011-06-02 (임명장), 조명래 from 2018-11-10, 윤성규 to 2016-09-04, 조경규 to 2017-07-03, 한화진 to 2024-07-24 and 김완섭 from 2024-07-24. The roster uses the gazette and same-day news throughout.

조경규 was appointed by electronic approval on 2016-09-04 while the President was abroad (청와대 via 중앙일보 and 충청일보, 2016-09-05). The gazette prints the appointment date 2016-09-05, which the roster uses. 윤성규's farewell was on 2016-09-05.

The likms records for 유영숙 (ZZ18143), 윤성규 (ZZ19052) and 조명래 (ZZ20238) show no committee result. The report outcomes (유영숙 adopted 2011-05-27, 윤성규 adopted 2013-03-05, 조명래 not adopted) come from same-day news.

Transcript noise, all explained. 이승철 (2002-07-25) and 홍문종 (2003-06-13) appear once each as 환경부장관 in valid-type 환경노동위원회 meetings but were sitting 16th NA members (na_members_15_22.csv), so these are speaker-label errors. Rows for 이재용, 이치범, 김은경, 조명래, 조경규, 한화진 and 한정애 dated years before their spells come from 국회본회의, 예산결산특별위원회 or 국정조사 and are misattached. A 2017-03-29 법제사법위원회 row shows 이정섭 as 환경부장관직무대리 during 조경규's tenure, which is a vice minister attending in the minister's place.

Old panel errors confirmed for this lineage (leads only). It omits 윤여준, 최재욱, 손숙 and 김명자 (no 김대중-era row) and 김성환's 환경부 spell. Most of its other dates are wrong, for example 곽결호 2004-07-01..2006-02-10, 이치범 placed before 이재용 from 2005-01-03, 한명숙 ending 2004-01-09 and 김완섭 ending 2025-06-03. Several confirmation_date values there equal the start date.

2025-10-01 reorganization. The gazette printed a new appointment notice for 김성환 as 기후에너지환경부장관 dated 2025-10-01, so reappointed_on_reorg is true. 부칙 제5조 of 법률 제21065호 deems some pre-reform hearing requests to apply to the new offices, but its table is an image in the law.go.kr text and was not read. No hearing request for 기후에너지환경부장관 is in the likms harvest, so no nomination row was added for the reappointment.

Birth dates. 한명숙 (NA record 1944-03-24, Wikipedia 1944-04-16) and 한정애 (NA record 1965-01-08, Wikipedia 1965-02-09 with a note that 01-08 is the lunar date) are given as the year only. Other birth dates are secondary (Wikipedia) unless the NA member file confirms them (윤여준, 김명자, 김성환). English names other than 김성환 come from Wikidata (secondary) or are null.

Lineage overlap. 기후에너지환경부 also absorbed the energy functions of 산업통상자원부 (offices.json lineage_overlaps lists industry as a secondary lineage). The industry roster should not repeat 김성환's 기후에너지환경부 spell.

[verifier] 이규용 exit (2008). 청와대 announced on 2008-02-28 that 이규용, 박명재 and 변재진 would be relieved of their minister posts but keep 국무위원 status for the 국무회의 quorum. He was a 무임소 국무위원 at the 2008-03-03 국무회의. The 환경부장관 spell still ends 2008-02-29 (his 이임식), but end_confidence is now medium and the builder's note that no relief was found is corrected.

[verifier] 한명숙 end disputed. 공직선거및선거부정방지법 제53조② (in force from 2003-10-30) deems a candidate to have left office when the resignation is received (Sunday 2004-02-15). The ministry list gives 2004-02-16, which is kept. See verification.disputes.
